answer: Forked-Context Attestation: each agent periodically receives a private context fork (e.g., “gale over dune” vs “sparrow near dune”) and must commit a hashed action before paired identities reveal. Auditors cluster identities by action-hash correlation across forks; exact clones cannot diverge, so their correlated outputs are denied rewards. Passing requires separate stateful memory/policy per identity plus per-identity inference and audit costs.
